fields.label: Call Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this decision call execution.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
success
unsupported
unavailable
authentication_failed
invalid_response
timeout
rate_limited
failed
fields.description: Current status of this decision call (pending, completed, failed, etc.).

fields.label: Surface
fields.description: Where this decision was invoked from (tool, skill, flow, etc.).

fields.label: Policy
fields.description: The decision policy that was invoked.

fields.label: Policy Version
fields.description: The version of the decision policy that was used.

fields.label: Policy Fingerprint
fields.description: Hash of the policy definition used, for audit tracking.

fields.label: Resolved Provider
fields.description: AI Provider that resolved and ran this decision call.

fields.label: Resolved Deployment
fields.description: Decision Deployment that was selected and used to run this call.

fields.label: Requested Model
fields.description: Decision Model initially requested for this call.

fields.label: Resolved Provider Model Id
fields.description: The model identifier as it is known to the provider (e.g., jev-1.13-free).

fields.label: Decision Model
fields.description: The decision model used for this call.

fields.label: Resolved Model
fields.description: The specific model version that was resolved and used.

fields.label: Resolved Model Version
fields.description: The version of the resolved model.

fields.label: Backend Adapter
fields.description: The adapter that translated the policy to the backend (e.g., System One).

fields.label: Agent
fields.description: The Agent this decision call was associated with, if any.

fields.label: Agent Run
fields.description: The Agent Run this decision call was associated with, if any.

fields.label: Flow Run
fields.description: The Flow Run this decision call was associated with, if any.

fields.label: Flow Node Id
fields.description: The Flow node ID this decision call was associated with, if any.

fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: The Conversation this decision call was associated with, if any.

fields.label: Automation
fields.description: Automation that triggered this decision call, if any.

fields.label: Owner User
fields.description: User who owns this decision call (for visibility permissions).

fields.label: Shadow Of
fields.description: Reference to the production outcome this shadow call was comparing against (for agreement reports).

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: The mode this decision call ran in: Manual (Playground/API), Shadow (logged without effect), Advise (hint only), or Enforce (applied).

fields.label: Origin Type
fields.options:
Playground
API
Agent
Flow
Automation
Hub
Gateway
Knowledge
fields.description: The surface or component that originated this decision call.

fields.label: Started At
fields.description: When this decision call began execution.

fields.label: Ended At
fields.description: When this decision call completed or failed.

fields.label: Latency Ms
fields.description: How long this decision call took to execute, in milliseconds.

fields.label: Candidate Count
fields.description: How many candidates were returned by this decision call.

fields.label: Candidate Ids Json
fields.description: JSON array of candidate IDs returned by this decision call.

fields.label: Answer Json
fields.description: JSON containing the full answer or result from this decision call.

fields.label: Confidence
fields.description: Confidence score of the decision, never treated as permission (always permission-filtered first).

fields.label: Probabilities Json
fields.description: JSON with probability scores for each candidate.

fields.label: State Hash
fields.description: Hash of the state snapshot used in this decision call.

fields.label: State Snapshot
fields.description: JSON snapshot of the state provided to the decision call.

fields.label: Question Snapshot
fields.description: JSON snapshot of the question or criteria provided to the decision call.

fields.label: Input Tokens
fields.description: Number of input tokens used by this decision call.

fields.label: Output Tokens
fields.description: Number of output tokens used by this decision call.

fields.label: Cost
fields.description: Cost of this decision call in USD.

fields.label: Cost Source
fields.description: How the cost was calculated (quoted, metered, etc.).

fields.label: Gate Result
fields.description: Result of the chat guard check (allowed, denied, etc.).

fields.label: Fallback Action
fields.description: Action taken if the deployment failed (next deployment, error, etc.).

fields.label: Deployment Selection Source
fields.description: How the deployment was selected (default, routing, etc.).

fields.label: Deployment Fallback Chain
fields.description: JSON array of deployments tried in fallback order.

fields.label: Deployment Fallback Count
fields.description: How many times the fallback to another deployment occurred.

fields.label: Error Code
fields.description: If failed, the error code from the backend.

fields.label: Error Message
fields.description: If failed, a human-readable error message.
